scope: production model invocation boundaries owned by this repository

entries.logical_boundary: one logical call per public operation generation request
entries.queue_behavior: LlmDispatchQueue when installed; direct compatibility fallback before boot/tests
entries.current_capture: operation_llm_telemetry emits a scoped response-boundary event; structured callers explicitly report validation success or failure while transport-only callers leave validation unattempted
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after operation-family validator and lineage coverage gates

entries.logical_boundary: one logical call per inline chat generation or tool-loop model turn
entries.queue_behavior: direct ConfiguredRouter route with bypass counters
entries.current_capture: chat service emits exact per-model-call receipts, presented response usage and stable chat turn/session lineage for every tool-loop generation
entries.phase1_adapter: exact chat turn/call adapter with one call id per generation and one shared turn root
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after chat_turn_id and presentation lineage

entries.logical_boundary: one logical call per streaming inline chat model turn
entries.current_capture: stream terminal response carries the exact logical-call receipt plus usage/TTFT when available
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after final response and turn contribution linkage

entries.logical_boundary: one parent logical operation with one or more child provider calls
entries.queue_behavior: uses the operation-router dispatch adapter; direct adapter only when queue is explicitly unavailable
entries.current_capture: one non-billing parent summary plus physical map/repair/fallback/reduce calls emitted centrally through the runtime bridge with exact receipts, typed parent relation, role, chunk tags and provider usage
entries.training_eligibility: eligible only with root/chunk/reducer lineage; shadow-eval calls excluded from production outcomes

entries.logical_boundary: one OpenAI vision call made by the analyze_image_via_openai compiled capability
entries.queue_behavior: shared operation router and LlmDispatchQueue; exact-receipt direct compatibility fallback only when the queue is unavailable
entries.current_capture: compiled dispatch propagates tenant, task/chat and execution identity; the operation telemetry bridge emits provider usage/cost and the router centrally emits exact queue-disabled failures
entries.phase1_adapter: compiled-dispatch inherited trace context reused by the operation router without a second logical call id
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after the vision validator and downstream tool-result acceptance; raw image and description content remain outside Phase 2 facts

entries.logical_boundary: one supporting local summarisation child call inside a queued parent
entries.queue_behavior: direct Ollama provider invocation to avoid recursive queue deadlock
entries.current_capture: local-prep emits an independent supporting child call and terminal provider-attempt fact; its duration also remains on parent dispatch timing
entries.training_eligibility: supporting-only; never inherit the parent task reward as a primary call

entries.logical_boundary: provider response inside a direct browser WebRTC session
entries.current_capture: response.created establishes backend timing and stable call identity; response.done forwards coarse totals plus a complete internally consistent modality/cache split when available through the scoped control channel into one durable canonical call and attempt
entries.phase1_adapter: server-scoped realtime response bridge with one pre-completion call id per provider response and active chat-turn lineage
entries.training_eligibility: eligible when response timing and detailed modality usage are present; coarse-only usage remains captured with unknown pricing

entries.logical_boundary: one billable upstream response when the provider exposes response usage
entries.current_capture: scoped LLMResponseReceived with response-boundary identity/start, honest coarse-or-detailed usage and measured response latency; active provider errors close the same call with a content-free failure class
entries.phase1_adapter: pre-completion realtime response identity plus session rollup
entries.training_eligibility: eligible only where provider response boundaries are exact

entries.current_capture: scoped LLMResponseReceived with pre-injection identity, exact start, honest missing/coarse usage and failed timeout/empty-audio classification when the meeting owns a broadcaster/scope
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after addressed-turn and meeting outcome linkage

entries.logical_boundary: one observable external coding run; opaque inner model calls are not fabricated
entries.current_capture: reported aggregate model/profile/tokens/cost remains in the compatibility LLM view; canonical call/attempt capture explicitly ignores the aggregate
entries.phase1_adapter: external_ai_run aggregate with zero physical attempts; no provider attempt is fabricated
entries.training_eligibility: excluded from provider-call training until the external engine exposes exact inner call and attempt receipts

entries.phase1_adapter: reuse operation-router identity instead of creating a second call id
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after body/privacy policy and downstream acceptance validator

entries.queue_behavior: operation router with local-only policy where configured
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after source provenance and downstream evidence acceptance

entries.logical_boundary: transport implementation, not a new caller-owned logical call
entries.current_capture: usage and provider response normalization return to the owning boundary
entries.training_eligibility: never create independent logical training examples from adapter internals

entries.logical_boundary: operator-invoked evaluation traffic outside production execution
entries.training_eligibility: synthetic/eval only; never merge with production bandit outcomes

entries.logical_boundary: tool subprocess owned by a skill rather than Magician's model control plane
entries.training_eligibility: excluded from model-routing training unless a future explicit provider bridge is added

entries.logical_boundary: specialized media or embedding/generation operation, not a text/realtime response call
entries.training_eligibility: excluded from v1 LLM response-training snapshots

entries.logical_boundary: one provider-executed web search LLM call made by the web_answer compiled capability
entries.queue_behavior: shared operation router and LlmDispatchQueue; exact-receipt direct compatibility fallback only when the queue is unavailable
entries.current_capture: compiled dispatch propagates tenant, task/chat and execution identity; per-call search counts and citations ride the router response summary and settle into cost with server-web-search rates
entries.phase1_adapter: compiled-dispatch inherited trace context reused by the operation router without a second logical call id
entries.training_eligibility: eligible after the web_answer citations validator; query text and answer content remain outside Phase 2 facts
